reason: create_account_controller.js:274-276 checks only result.errors.email and result.values, then pushes result.values.email without a null check, so a nil or blank email would be added. In practice the server always sends the email key (users_controller.rb:199, attributes.slice), the client blocks blank-email submits, and emailValidation's blank check (create_account_controller.js:61) runs before the rejectedEmails lookup, so the effect is harmless.
